happens: fire glows, iron takes its shape
why: Working fire shapes the metal.

happens: trembles at the least breath of wind
why: Shows water's sensitivity, but nobody senses or knows anything ahead of seeing; the knowing part of intuition is missing.

happens: lies unthrown, outcome undecided
why: Shows chance not yet cast (Perth), no thorn and no protection.

happens: you sit down, accepted without question
lean into boulder, it shifts
lies watching over the whole flock
goes quiet to listen after twig snaps
why: Shows alertness to a possible threat; nothing is actually guarded or sheltered.

happens: spend savings because roof cannot wait
look for signs, sky tells nothing
says one sentence, table falls quiet
stretches empty, no landmarks anywhere
runs to meet you, wagging nonstop
spills over the brim of pail
why: Abundance from the cow overflowing.

happens: makes far farm look sharply near
is finished after a winter's knitting
stands bare, spines still waiting
why: The thorn as latent threat is shown; caution itself is only implied.

happens: fills with voices before the meal
readies itself underground, unseen
turns, whole fence moves with him
stir old skyr into milk, leave overnight
why: A small starter is planted to grow in the dark.

happens: floods the dark stalls at once
ram threatens at gate, you wait
sinks underground, resurfaces as a spring
open August jam in winter dark
why: Shows the stored reward of a past harvest; the turning and return of the cycle is missing.

happens: each cairn visible from the last
shavings curl away as wood is cut
each sees their own mountain
lies warm, nothing of it showing yet
why: Shows hidden potential and gestation (Ingwaz), not wisdom or speech.

happens: wades deep snow without slowing
laugh together the morning after quarrel
breaks through, glints on wet stones
why: Shows the sun arriving and sparkling; nothing becomes clearer or understood.

happens: come home by their mothers' path
presses flat toward its one hour of light
rakes the hayfield, then is gone
its pitch alone tells the news
takes first step across the floor
stay alive under ash till morning
why: Hiddenness is there, but the action is fire persisting (Kenaz); nothing of fate or the unknown at work.

happens: lies unthrown, outcome undecided
take left track, right one vanishes
why: Something is given up, but as a side effect of choosing; no cost paid for a cause or what is right.

happens: glints briefly, then silt covers it
pushes up through cold soil
strikes from clear sky, vanishes fast
worn smooth by earlier hands
settles and waits for you to listen
dark behind, light ahead
comes in low, laden with fish
cuts power, everything automatic stops
light on, you see empty chair
why: Light makes something known.

happens: goes mud to gold, year after year
has stopped, nobody winds it
why: Shows a standstill through neglect; nobody is waiting and there is no cold or ice.

happens: one offers, the other receives
felt in feet before it is seen
each imagines a different picture in wall
why: Shows imagination projecting onto a blank surface; nothing hidden is revealed.

happens: hands newborn to mother, steps back
reach the cairn, sun on face
keep your word at cost of sleep
bends round lava, returns to its line
ices over and waits
so bright you narrow your eyes
find rhythm, stop counting steps
matches stride to yours, going evens
stands still while all else turns
why: Shows a fixed, constant point of orientation (Tiwaz), the opposite of something unwritten.

happens: roots in dark, crown in light
merges into choir, stays yours
takes the wind, doorway stays calm
is sold, proceeds carry household through winter
keep knitting as yarn runs out
why: Shows persistence under scarcity; no growth or change that comes from the hardship.

happens: has changed the room while you slept
note changes, you hear without looking
why: Shows a signal being heard (message/attention); no insight or counsel is gained.

happens: look for name, nothing written
all laugh at the same story
lives if fed, dies if forgotten
why: Shows that a living thing needs tending; wealth or possessions themselves are not in the scene.

happens: lies frozen in while fjord is open
sit down, nothing calls you up
lets nothing through without cost
laughter carries, nobody hurries in
lies in frozen ground, waiting
lift the end nobody else could
waltz, no telling who leads
stop ordering, sofa gets down stairs
grasp door handle and stop
meets stone, goes round it
lengthens slowly toward spring
why: Shows the slow turn of the year; nobody waits or holds back, so patience is not enacted.

happens: see where you stand on slope
burns alone over the workbench
why: An outer lamp in a static scene; nothing inner is lit and nothing happens.

happens: laughs differently, still recognisably themselves
look for signs, sky tells nothing
why: Shows the unknown and unreadable (Blank); no wealth or goods anywhere.

happens: taken down for feast after autumn
tears sleeve one step before edge
never quite sets at Midsummer
stands on the old foundations
scrapes empty before boat arrives
hangs in dark water, untouched
calls your name, other sounds drop
take first steps outside in May
turns, whole fence moves with him
why: Shows raw animal power (Uruz); nothing is given up.

happens: pushes your car out, just waves
fog lifts, reveals an unmissed sheep
takes strain, holds the ground
leads ducklings to water
come in, stove already lit
take one thing, leave the rest
carries plover's call to you
is blasted, daylight shines through
each imagines a different picture in wall
why: A blank surface holds whatever is brought to it.

happens: tears down fence, field lies open
is struck, room regains its shape
last hay is in, barn full
still runs audibly beneath the ice
why: Ice is present, but the action is flow continuing underneath, the opposite of ice's standstill.

happens: returns one thing, keeps another
is mirrored in another's eyes
stand up for the absent person
why: Shows speaking up for fairness (Tiwaz), an act, not stillness.

happens: beats big brother at arm-wrestling
pack only what you cannot lack
stands still while all else turns
why: The fixed star that does not shift is Tiwaz's truth.

happens: look back, tracks form one line
falls straight, covers all soundlessly
keeps hayfield bright past bedtime
winds of its own accord
why: A static path with nobody moving along it; rhythm of travel is missing.

happens: one slows for the other, arrive together
changes colour with the seasons
why: Shows the seasonal cycle (Jera), instinct rather than mind.

happens: stays green under snow all winter
recognise yourself by your stance
lid on, smell betrays something forming
catch sold, money becomes new nets
presses close for warmth in cold
why: Shows need driving the lamb to shelter; no growth comes out of the hardship.

happens: returns after the blackest dark
speaking the problem reveals the answer
leaf through, reach a blank page
stands open in blizzard for anyone
grows back more the more pulled
dig out each other's doors in turn
turn hay on the one dry afternoon
lies warm, nothing of it showing yet
run barefoot onto the dry grass
finds its own way downhill
comes down bigger than in spring
sled glides once they pull together
grows sheltered by older trees
go back into storm for one sheep
has outlived everyone who planted it
dries hour by hour until ready
reaches into valley, lights the farm
stay alive under ash till morning
face in water moves only with you
paws snow, carrying foal until spring
why: Shows gestation and new life to come (Ingwaz); nothing dies or returns.

happens: hung since winter, now ready
goes quiet one word before boiling over
lifts its head, on guard
why: Shows alertness only; nothing is protected or sheltered in the scene.

happens: see squall coming long before arrival
why: Shows foresight and warning; the protective act or shelter itself is missing.

happens: sleep takes you mid-sentence
covers the track, untrodden
bell carries, you turn toward it
leafs out first on cold ground
stretch toward the light
tears free of bog, keeps going
washes up, carving unreadable
why: Chance arrival is there, but the weight of the scene is on the unreadable mystery, not on luck or a throw.

happens: bends flat in gust, rights itself
ewe gives birth, lamb finds warmth
why: The main action is birth; an act of tending or caring by the mother is not shown.

happens: song starts, the room joins in
stands in ruins, warm in memory
why: Nothing happens in the scene; the tie to home is asserted in words rather than shown, and the home itself is lost.

happens: bars the way, demands a jump
paws snow, carrying foal until spring
breaks off, page below blank
stings whoever passes too fast
lamp reveals a hairline crack
come up many times what went in
vanishes round the next bend
why: A static road with no traveller; shows the road and what lies ahead, not movement.

happens: gives and takes on the shore
see yourself reflected among the others
bends round lava, returns to its line
why: Shows a road keeping its course (Raidho); no exchange or evening-out between two sides.

happens: drive bar into frozen ground, it gives
breaks window, puts out candles
return change given wrongly in your favour
stays put through four families
will not give however you pull
swells overnight, sweeps away the bank
frosts and thaws the pane
finds the ford you cannot see
why: The rider is carried by the horse's knowing.

happens: keep knitting as yarn runs out
why: Shows persistence under scarcity (Nauthiz); nothing breaks through or changes.

happens: lies face down, unturned
stand up for the absent person
trail appears briefly, then vanishes
lights only a few steps ahead
hammers roof, melts in an instant
night becomes day unnoticed
arrives by boat, lies unopened
why: The message arrives but is not received or read; the communication itself does not happen.

happens: hush at midnight, then new day
runs into every house in valley
alone still stands after the storm
why: The clearing is implied, but the scene's focus is the survivor's endurance (Eihwaz), not what the storm changed.

happens: lend trailer, later receive lamb
changes colour with the seasons
stays hidden in burrow until ready
each pulls less, both are covered
runs grey, heavy with its load
why: Water carrying a burden from above is shown; nothing lies hidden below the surface or out of awareness.

happens: grows heavy with bilberries in August
lead horse, rope hangs slack
stretches out in the sun
why: Shows rest and the sun's warmth; an old animal lying down does not enact vitality.

happens: arrow aimed one way, held
stands bare between frost and leaf
coffee goes cold while you wait
glints on a frozen puddle
why: A glint of sun on ice; nothing is made clear or seen better.
